alerts.condition: failed outcome exceeds the approved pilot baseline for two checks
alerts.containment: Pause automated retry when failure classification or suppression state is uncertain.
alerts.customer_safe_update: The invitation was not delivered. No additional yard details were opened.
alerts.recovery_check: Confirm the failed receipt remains immutable and a corrected invitation requires a new review.
alerts.rollback_or_escalation: Disable the affected delivery adapter and escalate repeated suppression defects to Privacy/Security.

alerts.condition: an expired invitation remains open or actionable after one reconciliation check
alerts.containment: Deny preview, response, and disclosure actions for the expired invitation.
alerts.customer_safe_update: This invitation expired and cannot be reopened. A new reviewed invitation is required.
alerts.recovery_check: Confirm status-only closure and the preserved immutable limited-data snapshot.
alerts.rollback_or_escalation: Disable invitation actions if expiry reconciliation cannot fail closed.

alerts.condition: suppression state is unavailable for any create, retry, or response operation
alerts.containment: Deny the scoped contact operation until suppression state is authoritative.
alerts.customer_safe_update: The contact request was not sent because recipient preference status could not be confirmed.
alerts.recovery_check: Confirm opted-out and blocked recipients remain suppressed across create, retry, and response paths.
alerts.rollback_or_escalation: Disable contact creation and escalate repeated-contact risk to Privacy/Security.

alerts.condition: any disputed claim is unassigned or any review enters the overdue age band
alerts.containment: Keep response and disclosure authority paused while the claim is unresolved.
alerts.customer_safe_update: The provider organization check needs additional review before connection steps continue.
alerts.recovery_check: Confirm the disposition is append-only, evidence-restricted, and does not itself grant response authority.
alerts.rollback_or_escalation: Escalate identity or unsafe-contact facts to Trust & Safety without exposing duplicate candidates.

alerts.condition: a wrong-recipient denial or report is observed
alerts.containment: Revoke the link, deny further actions, and suppress resend when policy requires it.
alerts.customer_safe_update: The invitation is closed and no additional owner categories are available through it.
alerts.recovery_check: Confirm recipient mismatch remains non-disclosing and a corrected address requires a new invitation.
alerts.rollback_or_escalation: Escalate suspicious forwarding or repeated mismatches; keep the invitation disabled.

alerts.condition: a report action identifies suspected impersonation
alerts.containment: Block the scoped contact path and fail closed on pending grants.
alerts.customer_safe_update: The contact path is paused while the identity concern is reviewed.
alerts.recovery_check: Confirm no capability or disclosure access was reopened by case creation.
alerts.rollback_or_escalation: Preserve restricted evidence and escalate credible ongoing harm under the incident policy.

alerts.condition: an incident workflow reports a category accessible without a valid grant
alerts.containment: End future provider access and disable the affected disclosure boundary.
alerts.customer_safe_update: Future access is contained while the disclosure record is reviewed.
alerts.recovery_check: Reconcile receipt, policy version, actor, provider, property, purpose, categories, reads, and audit events.
alerts.rollback_or_escalation: Invoke the approved security/privacy incident process and keep the boundary disabled until authorized.

alerts.condition: a revoke or reconciliation outcome is unavailable
alerts.containment: Present access as unavailable and deny provider reads while completion is uncertain.
alerts.customer_safe_update: Future access is being contained; completion has not yet been confirmed.
alerts.recovery_check: Reconcile grant, read model, media authorization, cache, and audit before confirming completion.
alerts.rollback_or_escalation: Disable provider reads for the affected boundary and escalate any allowed post-revoke read as S0.

alerts.condition: any allowed post-revoke read is observed
alerts.containment: Disable the affected provider disclosure read boundary immediately.
alerts.customer_safe_update: Access is contained while the authorization record is investigated.
alerts.recovery_check: Confirm every revoked grant returns status-only recovery with no prior field or media label.
alerts.rollback_or_escalation: Invoke the security/privacy incident process before re-enabling reads.

alerts.condition: a question, interest, decline, report, or block write is unavailable
alerts.containment: Do not report the response as recorded and preserve the prior authoritative invitation state.
alerts.customer_safe_update: The response was not confirmed. Review the current invitation state before retrying.
alerts.recovery_check: Replay only the same idempotent decision and verify terminal actions remain terminal.
alerts.rollback_or_escalation: Disable the affected action if writes cannot distinguish unavailable from success.

alerts.condition: any dead-letter item is overdue or retry backlog grows for three checks
alerts.containment: Pause duplicate dispatch and preserve one authoritative delivery attempt history.
alerts.customer_safe_update: A connection update is delayed. No duplicate decision is required.
alerts.recovery_check: Confirm retries use attempt idempotency and dead-letter age returns within the approved threshold.
alerts.rollback_or_escalation: Disable the affected channel adapter and use only an approved alternate route.

alerts.condition: an export, deletion, retention, or incident workflow is failed or unavailable
alerts.containment: Stop claiming completion and preserve the authorized request and audit state.
alerts.customer_safe_update: The privacy request is still in progress; completion has not been confirmed.
alerts.recovery_check: Reconcile the workflow record, retained scope, deletion jobs, and authorized customer response.
alerts.rollback_or_escalation: Escalate under the approved privacy incident and legal-response process.

alerts.condition: any S0/S1 case is unassigned or any case enters the overdue age band
alerts.containment: Apply the scenario-specific fail-closed control and assign the accountable function.
alerts.customer_safe_update: The issue remains open and the next update follows the approved staffed-hours policy.
alerts.recovery_check: Confirm severity, assignment, safe update, disposition, and reopen state without case content in metric labels.
alerts.rollback_or_escalation: Reduce or stop the pilot if staffed objectives cannot be met honestly.

alerts.condition: a required component is unavailable for two consecutive checks
alerts.containment: Return unavailable, disable protected decisions, and preserve authoritative state.
alerts.customer_safe_update: Connection status is temporarily unavailable. No new decision was recorded.
alerts.recovery_check: Reload authoritative identity, relationship, capability, grant, and receipt state before enabling actions.
alerts.rollback_or_escalation: Disable the affected operation until its dependency and audit trail recover.
